scope_note: Corrective DET01 synthesis. Only exact same-period tax-account arithmetic, its explicitly conditional public-cost break-even identity and a unit conversion of displayed municipal meter history remain. Construction, employment, supplier, household, electricity, cooling, emissions, wastewater and county-effect models were removed because the audit did not bound the missing project inputs. This account is intentionally incomplete where direct evidence remains unbounded.

estimates.label: Aggregated 2025 project-linked property-tax account payments

period.label: City of Southfield tax year 2025; real and former-IFT commercial-personal account totals paid

scope.label: EdgeConneX DET01 2025 Southfield real and commercial-personal property-tax accounts; recipient allocation unavailable

interval.interpretation: Exact arithmetic over cited same-period claims, not a statistical estimate.

estimates.confidence_rationale: The arithmetic and account paid totals are exact, but recipient allocation and account completeness are unaudited.
estimates.decision_relevance: Presents recurring project-linked tax contribution without netting unmatched incentives or costs.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Recipient-level cash receipts, omitted project accounts and reconciliation to government financial statements

derivation.formula: 2025 real-property Total Paid + 2025 commercial-personal Total Paid
assumptions: The two source accounts refer to the same DET01 address and same tax year.
The aggregation does not assign payments among city, county, schools or other recipients.
The expired IFT account is not added to 2025 because its nonzero history ends in 2019.

limitations: Account Total Paid is not a recipient-level government receipt.
No net fiscal result is implied.
estimates.notes: Deterministic account aggregation; inspect both source claims.

period.label: City of Southfield tax year 2025; real and former-IFT commercial-personal account totals paid

scope.label: EdgeConneX DET01 2025 Southfield real and commercial-personal property-tax accounts; recipient allocation unavailable

interval.interpretation: Exact identity over cited payments, not an estimate of actual cost.

parameters.name: personal_property_tax_paid
parameters.transformation: Included in the same-scope break-even identity

estimates.confidence_rationale: The threshold identity is exact for the cited account payments, while actual same-scope cost is unobserved.
estimates.decision_relevance: States the fiscal decision threshold without fabricating a cost or net result.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Same-year marginal service and infrastructure expenditures allocated to the same recipient jurisdictions

derivation.formula: annual marginal same-scope public-service cost at break-even = aggregated 2025 project-linked account payments
assumptions: Actual marginal public-service and infrastructure costs are not inferred.
The historical IFT certificate is kept separate because its counterfactual tax value and period do not match the 2025 account aggregation.
A positive margin exists only below the threshold and a negative margin only above it.

limitations: Not an estimate of actual public cost.
IFT tax expenditure and recipient incidence remain unquantified.
estimates.notes: No positive or negative net fiscal result is asserted.

estimates.label: Unit-converted 362-day municipal water-meter withdrawal

period.label: 362-day meter interval from 2024-12-26 through 2025-12-23; not annualized

scope.label: EdgeConneX municipal utility account 019890-001, WATER2 meter, 21005 Lahser Road

interval.interpretation: Exact arithmetic over displayed whole billing-unit readings; not an audited calendar-year total.

parameters.name: cubic_feet_per_billing_unit

provenance.detail: City definition of one water billing unit

parameters.transformation: Converts displayed billing units to cubic feet

parameters.name: gallons_per_cubic_foot
parameters.transformation: Converts cubic feet to U.S. gallons

estimates.confidence_rationale: The displayed reads and City unit definition make the conversion reproducible, but the interval is 362 days, readings are whole units and the portal does not document meter/account completeness.
estimates.decision_relevance: Provides the only bounded facility resource quantity found without inferring utilization from rated electrical capacity.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Audited calendar-year meter data, all-meter completeness, withdrawal source, consumption, reuse and wastewater discharge

derivation.formula: (708 - 662) billing units × 100 cubic feet per unit × 7.48052 gallons per cubic foot
assumptions: The two WATER2 readings are cumulative readings on the same meter.
The Citywide billing-unit definition applies to this account.
The value is presented for the 362-day interval and is not scaled to 365 days.

limitations: Withdrawal is not consumption or wastewater discharge.
The portal does not establish whether WATER2 is the only active site meter.
The interval does not exactly equal calendar year 2025 and is not audited.
estimates.notes: Source-meter delta carried as a visibly modeled unit conversion because no compatible canonical direct-evidence metric exists.
